This method indicates that a property's value must be unique in the database.
A unique index is created on the property.

types.name: name
types.description:
The unique index's name. If not provided,
Medusa generates the name.

types.name: unique
types.description:
This method indicates that a property's value must be unique in the database.
A unique index is created on the property.
types.example: import { model } from "@medusajs/framework/utils" const User = model.define("user", { email: model.text().unique(), // ... }) export default User

children.name: dataType
children.description:
The runtime dataType for the schema. It is not the same as
the "$dataType".

children.name: $dataType
children.description:
A type-only property to infer the JavScript data-type
of the schema property
